label: batch-49
tail:
**Batch 49 authoring is complete:** 15 A-page items and 4 B-page examples are in place, with the A/B pages, manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, notes, and cross-batch record.

The results include the periodic projection and energy identity, an \(O(h^2+k)\) **velocity-only** estimate for smooth periodic Stokes data, BDF2 and rotational scheme definitions without rate claims, and conditional saddle-point Schur and spectral bounds. The B page includes explicit wall-defect, checkerboard, scalar saddle, and Fourier-mode examples.

All 19 Step 1 records are current `ready` with `owner:false`. Scoped checks passed: proof contracts (19/19), precheck (15 proof-bearing items), proof layout (53 steps), rendercheck (21 files), focused dependency check, content policy, coverage (18 harvested results), and source fetch (3/3). The full run’s item-level dependency check also passed (1,390 items across 142 pages).

The whole-run **batch-level dependency check remains blocked** by malformed YAML in the unassigned [`def-maxwell-edge-fem-semidiscretization.md`](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-maxwell-edge-fem-semidiscretization.md:24): its source title contains an unquoted colon. The autopilot status remains held for owner repair and recertification; it still lists batch 49 as missing at the dispatch-artifact level. I left engine state and verdicts untouched.

Key artifacts: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/projection-and-pressure-correction-for-incompressible-flow.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/projection-and-pressure-correction-for-incompressible-flow-examples.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-49.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-49.coverage.json), and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-49.notes.md).

The full-text treatments were fetched and stamped: [Guermond–Minev–Shen](https://people.tamu.edu/~guermond/PUBLICATIONS/guermond_minev_shen_CMAME_2006.pdf), [NPTEL Lecture 5.4](https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/112106061/Module_5/Lecture_5.4.pdf), and [Benzi–Golub–Liesen](https://www.ime.unicamp.br/~pulino/MT404/TextosOnline/bgl04.pdf).
